title: Bolt's Rooftop Rhythm
logline: A shy robot named Bolt overcomes its social anxiety and mechanical inhibitions to find freedom and joy dancing at a vibrant rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming shyness, self-expression, finding joy in connection

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A small, somewhat clunky robot with expressive optical sensors, initially very shy and hesitant.

characters.name: Maya
characters.one_line_description: A vibrant, kind-hearted human who is observant and encouraging, with a natural flair for dancing.

characters.name: Party Guests
characters.one_line_description: Diverse group of humans and perhaps a few other robots, enjoying the party atmosphere.

scenes.title: Arrival at the Party
scenes.summary: Bolt arrives at a lively rooftop party, feeling overwhelmed by the music and dancing. It stands awkwardly by the edge, observing.
scenes.setting: A vibrant rooftop party at sunset, city lights in the background, upbeat music playing.

scenes.title: Watching the Dancers
scenes.summary: Bolt watches the party-goers dancing freely, its optical sensors flickering with a mix of longing and apprehension. It mimics a small head bob.
scenes.setting: The dance floor of the rooftop party, close-up on Bolt's perspective.

scenes.title: A Friendly Invitation
scenes.summary: Maya notices Bolt's hesitation. She approaches with a warm smile and extends a hand, inviting Bolt to join the dance.
scenes.setting: Near the edge of the dance floor, slightly quieter area.

scenes.title: The First Sway
scenes.summary: Bolt, after a moment of internal processing, hesitantly takes Maya's hand. It attempts a simple, slightly stiff sway, a spark of rhythm igniting.
scenes.setting: Center of the dance floor, surrounded by other dancers.
scenes.mood: Tentative, hopeful, beginning to loosen up.

scenes.title: Finding the Beat
scenes.summary: Encouraged by Maya's laughter and cheers, Bolt's movements become smoother and more confident. Its gears whir more fluidly as it starts to enjoy the music.
scenes.setting: Amidst the other dancers, spotlights occasionally hitting them.

scenes.title: Dancing Free
scenes.summary: Bolt is now fully immersed, dancing with uninhibited joy and unique robot flair. Maya dances alongside, and other party guests cheer, celebrating Bolt's transformation.
scenes.setting: The bustling dance floor, vibrant lights, and smiling faces.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
